features.title: objects.delete
features.notes: JSON live-object DELETE supports generation selection, all four atomic conditions and empty 204; repeated deletion is 404. Scope: docs/en/slices/json-object-media.md; verification/remaining scope: docs/en/evidence/object-media.md.

acceptance_cases.description: OBJ-MEDIA-023..035/049: delete selected live data atomically, preserve failed conditions, return empty 204 or structured 404/412 and keep opened readers pinned; both storage race outcomes pass.
Committed overwrite/delete succeeds with deferred reclamation; restart clears the journal; Four-worker EOF-barrier races cover both mutation outcomes without staging/blob leaks.
Enforce IAM/ACL, retention/holds/versioning/soft-delete, userProject and production token replay.
repeated startup journal failure names the blob ID once and blocks readiness until fixed

sdk_evidence.transport: HTTP JSON; raw HTTP media upload, high-level Attrs/NewReader/Delete; Writer rejected 501

known_deviations: Unauthenticated local deletion; no permission, retention, hold, version-history or soft-delete semantics.
SPEC-008: mutation not-match returns 412 and mixed/missing condition precedence is a local rule.
SPEC-013: GET/DELETE tokens are accepted without replay; same-token repeated DELETE returns 404 after 204.
Deferred blob reclamation retries at startup; a repeated failure names the blob ID and blocks readiness until fixed. No background retry scheduler is implemented.

acceptance_cases.description: OBJ-MEDIA-001/016..026/031..032/037..043/049: resource strings/timestamps/hashes, exact whole-media bytes/headers, encoded links, read 304 versus 412, missing generation 404 and unsupported semantics rejection.
Early 413/501/400 is readable on loopback during an attempted 8 MiB body; bounded lingering close is implemented without causal attribution.
Implement Range/If-Range, ETag conditions, fields/full ACL projection, version/soft-delete selection, IAM, download redirect/header parity and token replay.
A progressing media download is truncated and its connection closed at the absolute request ceiling, before inactivity can expire.

sdk_evidence.transport: HTTP JSON; raw HTTP media upload, high-level Attrs/NewReader/Delete; Writer rejected 501

known_deviations: SPEC-009: ordinary alt=media returns direct 200; no production redirect flow.
SPEC-008/011/012: local condition precedence, missing upload MIME convenience, opaque ID/ETag/link choices and incomplete independent JSON header parity.
Range/If-Range, ETag conditions, fields, userProject and unsupported semantics return local 501; full omits ACL/owner; no strict auth or historical versions.
SPEC-013: accepted GET/DELETE retry tokens execute again without response replay.
Lingering close discards at most 256 KiB for 100 ms; early responses are readable on local macOS loopback, without establishing a causal benefit from lingering or every-platform delivery.

Both completed-body commit waits and queued advisory checks outlive body inactivity and receive 200; Closure without an explicit EOF marker aborts and preserves the previous object; Unreleased v2 is rejected read-only; v1 migrates atomically to v3 without an intermediate version; Committed overwrite/delete succeeds with deferred reclamation; restart clears the journal; Four-worker EOF-barrier races cover both mutation outcomes without staging/blob leaks; Early 413/501/400 is readable on loopback during an attempted 8 MiB body; bounded lingering close is implemented without causal attribution; Advisory checks reject before body consumption/staging; publication rechecks atomically.
Implement multipart/resumable/metadata uploads, custom metadata, ACL/IAM, encryption/encoding, full field/common parameter semantics and upload-token replay.

After immediate upload admission, one advisory 404/412 check precedes streamed body/hash errors; concurrent state changes are rechecked at publication; repeated startup journal failure names the blob ID once and blocks readiness until fixed; read-only preflight preserves rejected database and hot-WAL bytes
queued upload precheck deadlines, deterministic response framing/advisory precedence, immutable WAL-free rejection and immediate upload admission as applicable to this row.

Trickle upload expiry cancels all eight admitted incomplete bodies, preserves old generations and releases permits after cleanup; advisory and post-EOF wait expiry returns 503, with a timed-out complete body still able to commit.

sdk_evidence.transport: HTTP JSON; raw HTTP media upload, high-level Attrs/NewReader/Delete; Writer rejected 501

known_deviations: Media only; multipart/resumable, metadata/ACL/encryption/encoding and upload tokens return local 501; no permission enforcement.
SPEC-008/010/011/012: local mutation precedence/hash parser/error rules, unsupported Content-MD5, accepted missing Content-Type default and opaque resource/header choices.
Default 1 GiB local cap is configurable (1 byte..5 TiB); no production maximum-size or durability claim.

Body inactivity is suspended during advisory and post-EOF waits, which return 503 backendError after catalog_wait_timeout_ms (default 30000 ms) or the remaining absolute object_request_timeout_ms budget (default 900000 ms). A post-EOF timeout leaves the mutation outcome unknown: the commit may still complete, so re-read state or retry with preconditions. Background filesystem work and shutdown catalog close retain no execution bound; SQLite busy_timeout remains unchanged.
Unreleased schema-v2 catalogs are rejected read-only; automatic migration supports object-free v1 catalogs.
Deferred blob reclamation retries at startup; a repeated failure names the blob ID and blocks readiness until fixed. No background retry scheduler is implemented.
Lingering close discards at most 256 KiB for 100 ms; early responses are readable on local macOS loopback, without establishing a causal benefit from lingering or every-platform delivery.

SPEC-008: header validation and the known-size check precede immediate upload admission (excess: 503); one advisory bucket 404/condition 412 check precedes streamed-size, body and checksum errors independent of body timing. Concurrent state changes are rechecked at publication after body validation.

features.notes: Test Content-Length, chunked transfer, empty bodies, truncated bodies, Expect: 100-continue where applicable, connection reuse, and HTTP/2 flow control. Reject malformed or incomplete uploads without publishing partial objects. Bound header/parser state as well as body buffers.

features.title: Disconnected-client resource cleanup
features.notes: Project requirement: slow clients, cancelled tasks and broken upload/download streams release permits, file handles and buffers promptly. Distinguish abandoned ordinary uploads from resumable sessions that must remain recoverable; verify no resource growth across repeated disconnects.

features.title: Disk exhaustion and write failure integrity
features.notes: Project requirement: inject full disk, inode exhaustion, permission failures and database-write failure. A failed upload must not corrupt the prior generation or expose partial state. Bound temporary-disk usage and report the local capacity limit explicitly.

features.title: File descriptor and active-session budgets
features.notes: Project requirement: cap open object files and persistent upload-session state independently of request concurrency. Spill/close idle handles and avoid O(number of stored objects) file descriptors; measure under many small objects and many abandoned sessions.

features.title: Catalog schema upgrade and compatibility policy
features.notes: Project requirement: version the persistent metadata format. Test upgrade with existing generations, permissions and resumable sessions; fail clearly on unsupported newer formats and avoid destructive implicit resets. Document downgrade/backup expectations.

features.title: Bounded telemetry and credential redaction
features.notes: Project requirement: structured request/operation IDs and bounded logging/metric buffers; avoid unbounded object-name or token label cardinality. Redact Authorization, signed query credentials, encryption keys and resumable capability URLs. Observability must not invalidate the memory target.

features.title: Safe blob reclamation during active reads
features.notes: Project requirement: overwrite/delete/lifecycle/restore/rename and background cleanup cannot reclaim bytes needed by an established generation-pinned read. Use a lifetime-aware reclamation strategy and test restart recovery of deferred/orphan bytes; do not hold long catalog transactions to protect readers.

features.title: Local IAM deny-policy evaluation boundary
features.notes: Allow-policy inheritance is already tracked. Add separately configured inherited deny rules only for supported Storage permissions, principals, exceptions and supported conditions; deny precedence must also affect ACL and signed-request decisions where applicable. Creating real IAM v2 deny policies remains outside the GCS emulator.

features.title: Organization policy effects beyond public access
features.notes: Local fixtures for Storage-specific constraints beyond existing PAP/UBLA rows, including authentication-type restrictions and permitted soft-delete retention settings. Document which constraint names and values are evaluated. Real Organization Policy administration is an external service.

features.title: Resource Manager tags and tag-binding boundary
features.notes: Bucket labels/XML tagging and Resource Manager tags are different features. Track direct/effective bucket tag bindings and their IAM/organization-policy uses. The real tagKeys/tagValues/tagBindings APIs belong to Resource Manager; an optional fixture adapter must be labeled simulated.

features.title: Tag-derived soft-delete defaults
features.interface: Bucket creation with external tag fixtures
features.notes: Support an optional inherited storage.defaultSoftDeletePolicy fixture for new buckets, with explicit bucket settings and allowed organization-policy values. Existing buckets must not be silently rewritten when the default changes; model propagation with a test clock if enabled.

features.title: Deprecated notification API scope registry
features.notes: Object change notification is deprecated as of 2026-01-30; it is distinct from Pub/Sub notification configuration/events already tracked. Record a deliberate historical support decision and exact source/version. Do not recreate old watch/channel endpoints by guesswork or infer shutdown merely from deprecation.

features.title: Behavioral release-note and restriction drift review
features.notes: Schema/proto drift is already tracked. Add semantic review of release notes and feature compatibility tables even when the wire schema does not change, for example lifecycle treatment of empty HNS folders, defaults, protocol restrictions, launches and deprecations. Add dated acceptance cases without overwriting prior compatibility claims.

features.title: ViewObjectFullContext v2 HTTP binding
features.notes: Track this observed v2 HTTP binding separately from google.storage.control.v2.StorageControl/ViewObjectFullContext and from storage.objects.viewFullContext in live v1 Discovery. Preserve exact resource-name encoding, context selection, generation and permission behavior; validate real accepted route/parameter forms before claiming aliases.
